Hi Claire —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key notes
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost on nightly batch rerank while keeping 95th pct latency under 120ms for our search ranking model.
- Data: FinOptics will want in-flight logging + audit retention for 90 days (per compliance).
- Success metric: end-to-end latency + cost per 1M tokens.

Proposed pilot scope (attached MPA v1)
- 2-week technical spike (integration + sample load)
- 4-week pilot with dedicated capacity if spike is successful
- Evaluation owner: Claire (Product), Eng owner: TBD (FinOptics), Redwood PM: Vivek

Ask: please review the attached MPA (mpa-finoptics-v1.pdf) and confirm the internal owners for "Evaluation owner" and "Eng owner" and whether the proposed pilot dates (week of Oct 18 start) still work. I've called out dates in the doc and left comment markers where we need your internal contact.

If you prefer, we can add a short 20-min sync next week to lock owners — I'm happy to block time.
